# QCAD MCP

> AI-driven 2D CAD automation — DXF/DWG parsing, SVG preview, STL extrusion, room analysis, DXF creation, persistent file depot with full CRUD. FastMCP 3.2 server on port 10966.

## Tools
- `plan_info` — DXF metadata: layers, entity counts, bounding box, blocks
- `plan_to_svg` — DXF to SVG preview with layer filtering
- `plan_extrude` — DXF walls to 3D STL mesh (default h=3m, t=0.3m)
- `plan_export` — DXF to SVG/PNG/PDF
- `plan_analyse` — Room detection, area calculation, door/window ID
- `plan_create` — Create DXF from geometric primitives
- `plan_depot` — List persistent CAD depot files with metadata
- `plan_modify` — Layer rename/freeze/lock, entity offset/delete
- `plan_agentic` — Natural language CAD goal → ECMAScript script → execution
- `plan_transpile` — AutoLISP to QCAD ECMAScript conversion
- `cad_sampling` — Host LLM reasoning for CAD problems (via MCP sampling)
- `plan_blocks` — Search CAD block libraries (cadblocksfree, biblocad)
- `plan_scripts_search` — Search QCAD ECMAScript script libraries

## Prompts
- `cad_expert` — Get CAD expertise and tool guidance
- `cad_analyse_plan` — Analyse a DXF floor plan step by step
- `cad_extrude_3d` — Extrude a DXF floor plan to 3D STL mesh

## Resources
- `cad://depot` — List all files in the persistent CAD depot
- `cad://depot/{filename}` — Get info about a specific depot file

## Architecture
- Core: ezdxf 1.4 (pure Python, no binary deps)
- Optional: QCAD Pro for ECMAScript bridge, native rendering, DWG
- Persistent depot: %LOCALAPPDATA%\qcad-mcp\depot
- REST API: http://localhost:10966/api/v1/
- Webapp: http://localhost:10967
